rules.statement: When contributor documentation shows a command for fixing a failure that a check script reports, keep it in line with the commands the script prints, and cover the case where several problems need their flags combined in one command (for example `--reset-author` together with the hook-running amend).
rules.why: A contributor who follows a documented example that leaves out a flag the script adds for a combined case ends up with a commit that still fails the check.
rules.check: When a diff changes docs that show remediation commands, or changes the script that prints them, compare the two. Flag any case or flag the script handles (such as an agent-account author) that the docs neither show nor mention.
